item.title: From 2024: Ralph Macchio on playing "The Karate Kid"
item.description: On Jan. 29, 2026, the Library of Congress named "The Karate Kid" – a beloved 1984 tale of a young boy learning important life lessons from his mentor, a martial arts instructor – to the National Film Registry, to be preserved for future generations. item.title: "Inception," "The Karate Kid" among films added to National Film Registry
item.description: Among the 25 films selected by the Library of Congress to be preserved for future generations are "The Big Chill," Wes Anderson's "The Grand Budapest Hotel," the Civil War drama "Glory," and John Carpenter's "The Thing."

item.title: Dozens confirmed dead as extreme cold continues to grip much of U.S.
item.description: The death toll continues to rise from a massive winter storm that left an ongoing spell of freezing weather in its wake.

item.title: Indonesian couple caned for sex outside marriage and drinking alcohol
item.description: The Sharia police chief in Indonesia's Banda Aceh province is unapologetic about the latest canings, imposed for behavior he said, "tarnishes our name."

item.title: Families adopting internationally face more hurdles with Trump's latest travel bans
item.description: Unlike earlier travel bans, President Trump's latest restrictions on travel from dozens of countries make no categorical exception for adoption-related visas.

item.title: Husband testifies he did not plot wife's killing despite affair with au pair
item.description: Brendan Banfield testified he and Juliana Peres Magalhães did not plot to kill his wife and another man despite what prosecutors suggest.

item.title: Life expectancy in U.S. hit record high of 79 years in 2024, CDC says
item.description: U.S. life expectancy rose to 79 years in 2024 - the highest mark in American history. But the U.S. still ranks below dozens of other countries.

item.title: Sneak peek: The Sneak Attack on Katlyn Lyon
item.description: ALL NEW: A mother goes viral on TikTok demanding justice for her murdered daughter. "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty reports Saturday, Jan. 31 at 10/9c on CBS and streaming on Paramount+.

item.title: Driver in custody after car crashes into Chabad headquarters in Brooklyn, police say
item.description: The incident is being investigated as a possible hate crime, authorities said.

item.title: Sen. Amy Klobuchar announces run for Minnesota governor
item.description: Sen. Amy Klobuchar on Thursday launched her campaign to be Minnesota's next governor, a surprise twist in the race for the top job in the state as it experiences an unprecedented immigration enforcement operation that's ignited a national debate.
